### Added
- **`gitops.prereleases` widens the agent chart line agent-manager composes for every agent.** On, `agent-manager.agentChart.semver` admits pre-releases (`>=1.5.0 <2.0.0` renders `>=1.5.0-0 <2.0.0-0`) and `agent-manager.agentChart.semverFilter` is the release tag filter, in the agent-manager release and in the connectivity release, whose migrate Job passes it as `AGENT_CHART_SEMVER_FILTER`. An `agentChart` with its own `semverFilter`, or pinned to an exact version, is left as written. `components.agent-manager.versionRange` moves to `>=1.7.0 <2.0.0` and `agentManager.migration.image.tag` to `1.7.0`, the first agent-manager whose schema and `migrate` take `agentChart.semverFilter`.
